Local linearisation integration step

Source: R/expm.R
dcm_dx.Rd

Computes a one-step Bayesian update dx = (expm(t*J) - I) * J^{-1} * f via an augmented matrix exponential. Mirrors SPM25's spm_dx.

dcm_dx(dfdx, f, t = Inf, Q = NULL)

Arguments

dfdx

Jacobian df/dx of the model.

f

Current residual / gradient.

t

Step length (or list with a single regulariser).

Q

Optional skew matrix.

Value

Update dx matching the structure of f.
